items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: I played over there so the time when Miss Mary used to have it

ctx.x: That's the place that burned down right here at the corner. That's right. Yeah, I remember, I never did go there, but I remember once when the people told me you were working there. Must have been 15 years ago or 10 years ago. Oh yeah. A little longer there. I just remember.
I played over there so the time when Miss Mary used to have it, please. Over at the Feet's Blacksmith Shop. Yeah.
The Feet's Blacksmith Shop. Yeah. What did you use then? You used your guitar? Sometimes I was guitar, sometimes I used my group. You used your what?
